# final_report/ -- 1000genome-workflow dftracer pipeline (run 1000genome_workflow/20260725_203603)

This folder is a self-contained reproduction package. It requires NO access to
the original session workspace's memory/conversation -- only what is in this
directory, plus a Flux allocation on Tuolumne.

## 1. Copy this folder

```
cp -r final_report/ /somewhere/else/
cd /somewhere/else/
```

## 2. Edit config.ini

Open `config.ini` and set `WORKSPACE_ROOT` to wherever this session's full
workspace lives on your system (it contains the pre-built Pegasus/Condor/PMC
toolchain and the annotated source under `<WORKSPACE_ROOT>/annotated/`,
`<WORKSPACE_ROOT>/baseline_4node/`, `<WORKSPACE_ROOT>/opt1/`). `config.ini` is
the ONLY file in this package that should ever contain a real filesystem path
-- every script under `scripts/` sources it via `scripts/lib_load_config.sh`.

## 3. Run the scripts, in order

```
bash scripts/install.sh              # TODO stub -- see note below
bash scripts/run_all.sh <alloc-id>   # runs smoke -> baseline_4node -> opt1
```

`run_all.sh` accepts the Flux allocation id as `$1` or via `FLUX_ALLOC=<id>`.

Individually, `run_all.sh` calls, in order:
- `scripts/run_smoke_individuals.sh` -- standalone `individuals.py` smoke test (no allocation needed, ~16s)
- `scripts/run_baseline_4node.sh` -- 4-node/32-rank PMC DAG baseline run (expect ~316.5s)
- `scripts/run_opt1.sh` -- same DAG with `IND_ROW_PRECOMPUTE=1 IND_TAR_STREAM=1` (expect ~244.7s)

Other scripts in this folder:
- `scripts/lib_load_config.sh` -- sourced by every other script; loads `config.ini`, validates `WORKSPACE_ROOT`, sets up `OUTPUT_ROOT`.
- `scripts/render_pdf.sh` -- regenerates `REPORT.pdf` from `REPORT.md` standalone.
- `scripts/readme_smoke_test.sh` -- static check that this README documents every script.

**Note on `scripts/install.sh`:** it is currently a documented TODO stub. This
session's Pegasus/Condor/PMC toolchain and dftracer install were done
interactively (see `plan/pipeline_plan.md` STEP 2/3 for the exact commands);
a from-scratch install script was not completed this session -- see
`REPORT.md` Section 13 (Remaining Work).

## 4. What "it worked" looks like

Compare your reproduced run's wall times against `REPORT.md`:
- Section 2 (Baseline Detail table) for the headline numbers (316.5s baseline_4node, 244.7s opt1, 15.61s smoke).
- Section 7 (Optimization Ledger), row 10, for the -29.3% delta this whole pipeline is built around.
- Section 12 (Reproducibility Validation) for exactly what WAS and was NOT re-confirmed in this session's own validation pass, and the two script bugs that were found and fixed there.

"Within noise" for this workload means: the smoke test should land within
roughly +/-15% of 15.61s (single-process, low variance); the 4-node DAG runs
are currently only single-replicate on both sides, so treat any 4-node
reproduction within roughly +/-10% of 316.5s/244.7s as consistent, and note
that PMC's own rescue-file mechanism means you MUST see real per-task
execution output (not an instant `duration=0.001` cluster-summary) for the
run to count as a genuine reproduction, not a resume no-op.
